posts.text:
Black entrepreneurs changed the world with two turntables and a microphone. Hip-hop is now a global economy, a fashion industry and a language spoken by billions. What comes next will be bigger.

Private space exploration. Biotech. Quantum computing. AI. These are young industries, and the ground floor is still open.

If we show up for this moment, the next decade could generate more Black wealth than any period in American history.

What are you building?

Graham Platner puts Democrats at an important crossroads. Are we going to hold the moral standard that Republicans abandoned? 

Or is the greater good to be found in doing whatever it takes to retake the U.S. Senate— even with a flawed candidate?

I believe in redemption. But redemption requires accountability and honesty. I hope Platner does better on those two counts, going forward. Regardless, the people of Maine have a tough decision.
